metadata.question: Was the vegetation anomaly in February 21-28 2019 (compared to the long-term average of the same month from 2003-2017) worse in Namibia than Zimbabwe?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare vegetation indices (NDVI) for Feb 21-28, 2019 vs. long-term average (Feb 2003-2017) for both Namibia and Zimbabwe - Use Landsat 8 (available from 2013) or Sentinel-2 (from 2015). For the baseline period 2003-2017, use Landsat 5, 7, 8. - Focus on Feb 21-28 each year in the baseline period 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds to get reliable vegetation data - Calculate NDVI for each period - Compute anomaly as: (NDVI_Feb2019 - mean_NDVI_Feb2003-2017) / std_NDVI_Feb2003-2017 - Compare anomaly severity between countries 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - If no images found for 2019 or baseline periods → C1 - If valid pixels = 0 after cloud masking → C2 - If NDVI or anomaly is NaN/None → C3 - Compare anomalies: if Namibia anomaly worse (more negative) than Zimbabwe → A, otherwise → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define geometries const namibia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [11.73, -17.08], [25.26, -17.08], [25.26, -28.97], [11.73, -28.97], [11.73, -17.08] ]]); const zimbabwe = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [25.26, -15.62], [32.83, -15.62], [32.83, -22.41], [25.26, -22.41], [25.26, -15.62] ]]); // Helper function to calculate NDVI function addNDVI(img) { return img.normalizedDifference(['B5', 'B4']).rename('NDVI').copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']); } // Function to mask clouds in Landsat function maskClouds(img) { const qa = img.select('BQA'); const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0); return img.updateMask(cloud); } // Get Feb 21-28 2019 data const feb2019Start = ee.Date('2019-02-21'); const feb2019End = ee.Date('2019-02-28'); // Get Landsat 8 collections for both locations const ls8_2019_nam = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C01/T1_TOA') .filterDate(feb2019Start, feb2019End) .filterBounds(namibia) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNDVI); const ls8_2019_zim = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C01/T1_TOA') .filterDate(feb2019Start, feb2019End) .filterBounds(zimbabwe) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNDVI); // Get baseline Feb 21-28 data (2003-2017) let baseline_nam = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C01/T1_TOA') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(21, 28, 'day_of_year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2003, 2017, 'year')) .filterBounds(namibia) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNDVI); let baseline_zim = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C01/T1_TOA') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(21, 28, 'day_of_year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2003, 2017, 'year')) .filterBounds(zimbabwe) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNDVI); // Check data availability const size_2019_nam = ls8_2019_nam.size().getInfo(); const size_2019_zim = ls8_2019_zim.size().getInfo(); const size_base_nam = baseline_nam.size().getInfo(); const size_base_zim = baseline_zim.size().getInfo(); print(`2019 Feb 21-28 Namibia: ${size_2019_nam} images`); print(`2019 Feb 21-28 Zimbabwe: ${size_2019_zim} images`); print(`Baseline Feb 21-28 Namibia: ${size_base_nam} images`); print(`Baseline Feb 21-28 Zimbabwe: ${size_base_zim} images`); if (size_2019_nam === 0 || size_2019_zim === 0 || size_base_nam === 0 || size_base_zim === 0) { print("Insufficient data for comparison."); print("C1"); return; } // Calculate mean NDVI for 2019 const ndvi_2019_nam = ls8_2019_nam.select('NDVI').mean(); const ndvi_2019_zim = ls8_2019_zim.select('NDVI').mean(); // Calculate baseline statistics const ndvi_base_nam = baseline_nam.select('NDVI'); const ndvi_base_zim = baseline_zim.select('NDVI'); const mean_base_nam = ndvi_base_nam.mean(); const mean_base_zim = ndvi_base_zim.mean(); const std_base_nam = ndvi_base_nam.reduce(ee.Reducer.stdDev()); const std_base_zim = ndvi_base_zim.reduce(ee.Reducer.stdDev()); // Calculate anomalies (standardized) const anomaly_nam = ndvi_2019_nam.subtract(mean_base_nam).divide(std_base_nam.select('NDVI_stdDev')); const anomaly_zim = ndvi_2019_zim.subtract(mean_base_zim).divide(std_base_zim.select('NDVI_stdDev')); // Get regional means const stats_nam = anomaly_nam.reduceRegion( {reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: namibia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9} ).getInfo(); const stats_zim = anomaly_zim.reduceRegion( {reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: zimbabwe, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9} ).getInfo(); const anomaly_value_nam = stats_nam['NDVI']; const anomaly_value_zim = stats_zim['NDVI']; print(`Namibia anomaly: ${anomaly_value_nam ? anomaly_value_nam.toFixed(3) : 'None'}`); print(`Zimbabwe anomaly: ${anomaly_value_zim ? anomaly_value_zim.toFixed(3) : 'None'}`); // Validate results if (anomaly_value_nam === null || anomaly_value_nam === undefined || isNaN(anomaly_value_nam) || anomaly_value_zim === null || anomaly_value_zim === undefined || isNaN(anomaly_value_zim)) { print("C3"); return; } // Compare: worse anomaly = more negative if (anomaly_value_nam < anomaly_value_zim) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
